'''Singe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he frequented [[Mariyk]]'s cantina in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Senate Commercial District]]. He sold powerful weapons and armor to other smugglers for a price.

==Behind the scenes==
Singe appears in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] MMORPG, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as a PvP vendor for smugglers on Coruscant.
